coaching.subject: acceptance criteria completeness and measurability

metrics.claim_path: no-llm/no-network (structural; the fast claim check is a local HMAC verify)

evidence: 6 criterion line(s) bundle multiple deliverables with 'and' (split so each is independently verifiable).
findings.suggested_fix: Split compound criteria, replace subjective terms with observable outcomes, and state how each is verified.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Add an explicit T3 acceptance criterion mirroring parent AC 13: a REAL-jira-3.10.5 offline test constructing jira.JIRA(..., max_retries=0, get_server_info=False, validate=False), asserting _session.max_retries==0 (not via fake transports), skipped when the jira-datacenter extra is absent.
evidence: Parent AC: 'A test against the REAL `jira` 3.10.5 library builds `jira.JIRA(..., max_retries=0, get_server_info=False, validate=False)` offline and asserts `_session.max_retries == 0` (not via fake transports); skipped when the `jira-datacenter` extra is absent.'

Parent Approach step 5: 'Validate this riskiest capability FIRST, in-session, against the REAL `jira` 3.10.5 library ... an offline construction test proves the knob before executor logic layers on it.'

T3 ACs only state 'The dedicated executor client passes `max_retries=0` and rejects a nonzero session value.' and T3 Testing says 'Include the proven Jira 3.10.5 constructor/session guard' — neither pins offline/real-not-fake-transport, the exact args, nor the skip-when-extra-absent condition as an assertion.

Repo convention confirms the extra-absent skip is a real, load-bearing gate (tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_rate_limit_retry_heldout.py:62 'The unit tier has no `[jira-datacenter]` extra'; pyproject.toml:201 declares the extra).
findings.finding: Parent AC 13 (a test against the REAL jira 3.10.5 library that builds jira.JIRA(..., max_retries=0, get_server_info=False, validate=False) OFFLINE, asserts _session.max_retries == 0 explicitly NOT via fake transports, and is SKIPPED when the jira-datacenter extra is absent) is only partially covered by T3. T3's acceptance criteria assert the generic outcome 'the dedicated executor client passes max_retries=0 and rejects a nonzero session value' (= parent AC 12) but do not surface AC 13's distinguishing conditions as assertable acceptance outcomes: (a) the test uses the REAL library and not fake transports, (b) the exact constructor arguments get_server_info=False and validate=False, and (c) the skip-when-extra-absent guard. Parent AC 12 and AC 13 are two separate criteria; no sibling (T1/T2/T4 do not touch DC construction) delivers AC 13's specific observable outcome, so the remainder is unnamed.
scenarios: The unit tier (no jira-datacenter extra installed) runs T3's constructor guard against a fake/stubbed jira, satisfying T3's ACs while never exercising the real SDK seam the parent's riskiest-capability AC demands.

A future jira version bump silently changes the constructor argument name; because no child AC pins the real-library offline assertion with exact args, the fail-loud guard the parent requires may not trip in CI.
findings.suggested_fix: Amend T3's acceptance criteria to add the parent's AC 13 verbatim (real library, exact constructor args, not-fake-transports, skip-when-extra-absent), keeping the existing 'passes max_retries=0 / rejects nonzero session' criterion as the separate AC 12 coverage.
